title: Red panda wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d="M76 74 Q92 70 90 84 Q88 94 76 92" fill="#c94f2a" stroke="#e8794f" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M84 76 Q88 80 86 86" stroke="#f2d3a0" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="26" ry="18" fill="#b8401f"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="15" ry="11" fill="#f2d3a0"/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx="27" cy="30" r="9" fill="#b8401f"/>
    <circle cx="27" cy="30" r="5" fill="#f5b8a0"/>
    <circle cx="73" cy="30" r="9" fill="#b8401f"/>
    <circle cx="73" cy="30" r="5" fill="#f5b8a0"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#c94f2a"/>
    <!-- face markings -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="17" ry="12" fill="#f7e2c0"/>
    <ellipse cx="38" cy="40" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#f7e2c0"/>
    <ellipse cx="62" cy="40" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#f7e2c0"/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx="38" cy="42" r="3.4" fill="#3a1e14"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="3.4" fill="#3a1e14"/>
    <circle cx="39.2" cy="40.8" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <circle cx="63.2" cy="40.8" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="51" rx="4.5" ry="3.2" fill="#3a1e14"/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d="M50 54 Q50 60 43 59 M50 54 Q50 60 57 59" fill="none" stroke="#6b3020" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- party hat -->
    <path d="M40 20 L50 -1 L60 20 Z" fill="#3fc4d8"/>
    <path d="M44 12 L56 12" stroke="#ffd84d" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="-1" r="3.5" fill="#ff6fa0"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="20" r="3" fill="#ffd84d"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="20" r="3" fill="#ffd84d"/>
  </g>
</svg>
